tasks.answer: The '航班延误补偿批次工作区' page component is flight-delay.FlightDelayCompensationBatchScreen (named export FlightDelayCompensationBatchScreen), imported from '@/features/flight-delay-compensation/batch-detail-screen'. It is the batch compensation workspace covering the standard, special and review steps. Its only required prop is batchId; it also needs query, auth and router providers and handles offline/conflict states.

No dedicated '特殊旅客' (special-passenger) booking-list variant exists in the catalog: a search for '特殊旅客预订列表 special passenger booking list' returned only the generic traveler booking list and unrelated hits, with no component whose summary/constraints mention special passengers. The closest (and only) booking-list component is bookings.TravelerBookingListScreen (named export TravelerBookingListScreen), imported from '@/features/traveler-bookings/booking-list-screen' — a paginated traveler booking list with search and filters. Required prop: navigate; initialStatus is optional, and queries/actions are permission-gated. Reuse is module-scoped (owner: bookings).

The password input box is auth.PasswordInput (default export PasswordInput) from '@/features/auth/password-input' — a password field with show/hide labels and a form-field error; it takes no required props. Error display: its `error` is a string and it must be used inside UiFormField (@/components/ui/form); the field wrapper renders the error message (the error string is shown by UiFormField, not by the input itself). Note: the underlying shared-ui primitive is ui.UiPasswordInput (@/components/ui/form, required props hideLabel/showLabel), where `error` is a boolean and the message likewise comes from the surrounding UiFormField; auth.PasswordInput wraps it and is the app-facing component (production usage 1, e.g. the new-password field in change-password-page).

The mobile booking list uses two shared-ui components, both named exports from the same module '@/components/business/mobile': (1) business.SearchBar (export SearchBar) — mobile search bar with an optional filter action; required props value, placeholder and onChange (onFilter is optional and adds the filter icon button). (2) business.FilterSheet (export FilterSheet) — bottom filter sheet with reset and confirm actions; required props visible, title, children and onClose (onConfirm runs before the sheet closes).

The global 认证恢复弹窗 is common.AuthRecoveryDialog (export AuthRecoveryDialog) from '@/components/common/auth-recovery-dialog'; it takes no required props. Mounting: mount it exactly once near the app root (global mount, not inside individual screens). It subscribes to the auth recovery store itself and lazily renders its view (AuthRecoveryDialogView), rendering null while no recovery event is pending.

notes: Budget-compliant run: exactly 5 searches (one per task, each '--limit 5 --details') plus a single combined get for task 3 (auth.PasswordInput + ui.UiPasswordInput) to disambiguate the two password-input entries; no other get. All commands were run from /tmp/oss-trial/airport-mobile against component-catalog.config.json, with COMPONENT_CATALOG_LOG=/tmp/audit-airport-ui55b/usage/catalog-1.jsonl and per-task COMPONENT_CATALOG_TASK. No project source files, config, or component-catalog.json were read; no ls/cat/grep/--help used. The get confirmed ui.UiPasswordInput is the shared-ui primitive behind auth.PasswordInput (its production example is src/features/auth/password-input.tsx). Task 2's 'no dedicated special-passenger variant' conclusion is based on that single search result set (top 5 of 19 matches), where no special-passenger-specific component appeared.
